titles.romaji: Chi ni Ueta Hanayome wa Ou o Kurau
titles.native: 血に飢えた花嫁は王を喰らう

description:
As the princess and shrine maiden of Albu, Kate must do something when her people are on the verge of losing their war against Verde, an enemy nation. So she releases Camilla, the vampire her ancestor sealed away centuries ago, and absorbs her blood powers to use against Verde's army. Knowing these powers alone can't keep Verde at bay forever, Kate boldly proposes a marriage alliance to Luca, the king of the most powerful nation on the continent. But will her new husband supply her with the blood she needs every night and satisfy her unbridled vampire lust?

(Source: Tappytoon)
